purpose: physical proof-load fixture at validated saddle stations

load_application.recommended: Use two pads, one per INNER_ARM. Place a rigid, flat spreader board across both pads and place a non-fragile test load on the board. Do not let the board contact OUTER_GUIDE, rotor, or fixed base.
load_application.support_surface: Rigid flat surrogate support under the complete adapter base; do not use the Magnat Sounddeck for the 500 N structural proof.
